subject: Fraud & Scams
title: Phishing for Identity Data
description: A 60-second lesson on Phishing for Identity Data.

hook.text: An email from 'your bank' asks you to verify your login. The link goes to a perfect fake site.

buildup.text: Phishing emails mimic trusted brands with identical logos, fonts, and formatting.

discovery.text: Modern phishing sites can capture your login in real time and use it before you even log out.

twist.text: AI-generated phishing emails have no spelling errors or awkward grammar — the old red flags are gone.

climax.text: Phishing remains the number one method for stealing digital identities worldwide.

punchline.text: The link looks right. The site looks right. Nothing is right.

quiz.question: Why are modern phishing emails harder to detect?
options: They come from real email addresses
AI removes the spelling errors that were old red flags
